audit.summary: The missing regularized base family contradicts nested spanning. Independently, single original-flow pullbacks fail in the core spanning-to-spray construction. Iterated enlargement supplies a bounded repair without lowering this core defect to Minor. Four further local corrections remain Minor; the final factorization theorem is not disproved.
limitations: Missing regularized base fields make the stated nested spanning family impossible — Counterevidence: Multiplication by a1² yields a complete polynomial translation field. Regularized finite base fields span every generic two-factor fiber. No non-factorizable null-homotopic holomorphic map found.

Single-flow pullbacks do not produce the asserted finite spanning family — Counterevidence: Iteratively pull back current Br, not just original A. On saturation, each irreducible rank-defect component admits an original-flow escape; common times by countable-component Baire argument remove every component generically. Dimension drops to empty in finite rounds.
The stated flow-composition order is reversed — Counterevidence: Group-generated saturation allows either order; intended escape consequence survives.
POP approximation definition omits holomorphic convexity of K — Counterevidence: Cor2.11 andThm2.12 may useKempty; lifting use not refuted.
Upper-block elimination has a doubled sign — Counterevidence: UseU(B); the remainingK_ni product and Whitehead identities survive.

Critical-value classification misses parity — Counterevidence: p26 already uses the correct unique even singular fiber. Smoothfibers subsetWK still valid, and piK generic/non-generic stratification unchanged.
